newsitem.title: POLAND: Kuehbacher says present dlr/mark level good.
newsitem.headline: Kuehbacher says present dlr/mark level good.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Klaus-Dieter Kuehbacher said in Warsaw on Wednesday that present relations between the dollar and the German mark were good but he did not give an exact rate.

"We have at this time good relations between the Deutschemark and the dollar and we have said before that last year or a year and a half ago it was a bad relation, but I don't want to give you the exact rate to the last penny," Kuehbacher told reporters at a banking conference in Warsaw.
Earlier on Wednesday Buba council member Ernst Welteke said the dollar rate at around 1.70 marks was supported by fundemental data. -- Tomasz Janowski +48 22 653 9700
